Reports and Recommendations of the President
Loan 2452: 100% of contracts awarded and 100% disbursed as of 17 Jun 2022

Progress Toward Outcome: Major change in Program was approved for restructuring the Program and revising the DMF. Tranche release conditions for all three tranches have been complied. The program has brought far-reaching changes to the sector, and has positively impacted the lives of about one million artisans and their families employed in khadi, including (i) increased earnings (72% increase from FY2010 to FY2017) resulting from market-linked pricing; (ii) financial inclusion (more than 90% artisans receiving wages through bank account and insurance cover) because of mandatory direct benefit transfers through bank accounts; and (iii) increased production and sales through support of direct reform assistance (DRA).

Status of Implementation Progress: All policy conditions under the program have been complied with.
Component 1: Policy reform and implementation framework
" Condition 1: Khadi and Village Industries Commission (KVIC) shall have ensured the completion of the audit of remaining 220 eligible khadi institutions by independent auditors
" Condition 2: KVIC shall have (i) undertaken an independent assessment of the Khadi Reform Package, (ii) held a stakeholder consultation on the outcome of the assessment, and (iii) prepared appropriate measures to address the feedback
Component 2: Promoting and Marketing Khadi
" Condition 3: KVIC shall have created the basic testing infrastructure for the Khadi Mark
" Condition 4: KVIC shall have continued to conduct random spot audits of khadi institutions regarding adherence to the licensing requirements for the use of Khadi Mark
" Condition 5: Based on the outcome of the survey, KVIC shall have identified products for both domestic and international markets and develop marketing strategies for all Khadi related institutions and products
" Condition 6: The KVIC shall have prepared a product catalogue and set up the market information system
Component 3: Realizing Procurement and Production Efficiencies
" Condition 7: KVIC shall have monitored and assessed the effectiveness of the implementation of the benefit chart
" Condition 8: KVIC shall have continued the phasing out of production incentives on other product categories and assess the impact on sales as a result of this
Component 4: Implementing Institutional Reforms
" Condition 9: : KVIC shall have implemented the management information system (MIS) in 400 khadi institutions
" Condition 10: KVIC shall have implemented the integrated application system
" Condition 11: KVIC shall have adopted the comprehensive reforms plan to empower and revitalize the 400 eligible khadi institutions
" Condition 12: KVIC shall have re-categorized the remaining khadi institutions using the modified norms
" Condition 13: KVIC shall have signed with 220 eligible khadi institutions the MOUs for comprehensive khadi institutions reforms
" Condition 14: KVIC shall have ensured that three hundred and twenty (320) eligible khadi institutions shall have implemented the comprehensive reforms plan
" Condition 15: KVIC shall have evaluated the performance of the four hundred (400) eligible khadi institutions
" Condition 16: KVIC shall have ensured the establishment of one cluster for each of the identified village industry
" Condition 17: KVIC shall have ensured the implementation of the comprehensive capacity building plan in the identified clusters
" Condition 18: KVIC shall have monitored the performance of the clusters.
